text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid focus ring at 9:1 contrast with a subtle 1px outer glow that fades in 120ms. This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while avoiding the harshness of a 7:1 ring. The glow adds a gentle cue for touch users without motion-triggered discomfort. Trade-off: the glow slightly increases rendering load, but it’s negligible on modern devices.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring with a 1px glow still risks disappearing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the glow blends into the pattern. A better alternative is a 2px ring at 10:1 contrast with no glow, relying on sharp edges to stay visible. Settle it by testing on 10 real patterned backgrounds with a screen reader user.
